d:
Pradhanmantri narendr modi ke bihar daure par prashant kishor ne vikas, palayan aur barh jaise muddon ko lekar saval uthae hain. PK ne nitish setu ka pura shrey nitish kumar ko dete hue kaha ki iska kontraikt 2014 se pahle ka hai. sath hi unhonne piem modi se puchha ki bihar dusre rajyon ki barabri kab karega aur palayan-barh ki samasya se kab mukti milegi?
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
